subject: Next steps for Novus vendor activation: security docs & PO
messages:
From: Alice Wong <alice.wong@novusplatform.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@novusplatform.com, legal@novusplatform.com
Date: Fri, 03 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor activation: security docs required

Hi Ben,

We got the green light internally to move Redwood to 'approved vendor' next week, but procurement requires a couple of items before we can issue the PO: the signed DPA, a recent (2026) SOC 2 report link, and a full subprocessor list with any EU-data flow notes. Can you share those and confirm whether Redwood supports customer-managed KMS and EU data residency options for this account?

Also please confirm invoicing steps and whether you need a W-9 or supplier form from us. Our desired go-live is 2027-04-12, so timely turnaround would help.

Thanks,
Alice Wong
Head of Procurement
Novus Platform

(attachment: novus_req_form.pdf - procurement checklist)

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: Alice Wong <alice.wong@novusplatform.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 03 Apr 2027 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor activation: security docs required

Hi Alice — thanks for the note and congrats on the green light. Below is everything you asked for and a short checklist so procurement can issue the PO without back-and-forth.

Quick answers up front:
- Customer-managed KMS: supported (bring-your-own-key via our KMS connector; we can walk through KMS onboarding).
- EU data residency: supported in our EU region (option to pin customer to eu-west-1 cluster).

Documents attached / links: 
1) Redwood_DPA_v1.3.pdf (attached) — this is our standard DPA; we can accept a redline but prefer annotate-in-place then DocuSign.
2) SOC2-2026-public-link.txt (contains link to our independent SOC 2 Type II report hosted on our compliance portal).
3) redwood_subprocessors_list.csv (exported list with primary subprocessors and country columns).

Procurement checklist (for your PO team):
- Provide PO number + billing contact (email + remit address).
- Indicate whether the Novus legal team needs to propose DPA redline or you want Redwood to send DocuSign.
- If Novus requires tax form, we accept W-9 (US) or W-8BEN-E (non-US).
- For EU residency: please specify the region in PO notes or we will default to us-east unless you request eu-west.

I attached the DPA and subprocessor list here. I also pasted the public SOC2 link into the attached text file for procurement to download. If you'd like, I can route the DPA through DocuSign now.

Next steps I propose:
- You share the PO number + billing contact by COB Monday (04/05).
- If redlines are required, Novus legal can upload to DocuSign and loop in Marissa (cc'd) for Redwood review.
- I will put a hard hold on capacity for the requested go-live date once PO is received.

Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

(attachments: Redwood_DPA_v1.3.pdf, redwood_subprocessors_list.csv, SOC2-2026-public-link.txt)

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 04 Apr 2027 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor activation: security docs required

Ben — quick legal check. I reviewed the DPA Ben attached. Two small asks from Novus we see often: 1) they request a 30-day data export assistance SLA in Section 6 — we can agree but recommend 'reasonable efforts' language instead of a strict calendar SLA; 2) they asked for an EU data transfer mechanism note — add reference to SCCs and our subprocessors list.

Suggested workflow:
- Accept their redline if minor; otherwise, we send an annotated DPA and route to DocuSign with Marissa as Redwood signatory.
- If Novus insists on an edit we don't accept, escalate to legal@redwood for approval (I can own that follow-up).

Also, add a line to the PO that states: "Service commencement subject to execution of DPA and receipt of PO." That prevents premature provisioning.

I can jump on a 15-min call Monday to clear final language.

-Marissa
Senior Counsel, Contracts
Redwood Inference

- PO number: NOV-38712
- Billing contact: Maria Chen (maria.chen@novusplatform.com)
- Remit: Novus Platform, Attn: AP, 120 Market St, Suite 500, San Francisco, CA 94105

Attached: Novus_PO_38712.pdf. We will route an internal DocuSign for the DPA and expect that Redwood signs within 48 hours. Please confirm receipt and confirm which email the DocuSign will come from.

Final question: for invoicing, do you require paper invoices mailed to the remit address or is email to ap@redwood.com sufficient?

Thanks — looking forward to go-live.
Alice
